subject: RE: Renewal & expansion: pricing follow-up — volume step-ups & blended rates
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Morrison <kmorrison@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: token volumes & next steps (post call)

Thanks again for the demo this morning — appreciate the clarity on routing and the Dedicated options. As discussed, here's our tentative volume profile for the next 12 months: 

- Month 1-3: 200M tokens/month (pilot)
- Month 4-6: 500M tokens/month
- Month 7-12: 1.2B tokens/month (target steady state)

A few follow-ups from our side: 
1) Can you confirm target unit economics (ballpark $/1M tokens) for a blended profile that includes routing to smaller models for short prompts and larger models for complex queries?
2) How do volume step-ups affect blended rates and the timing for applying lower tiers?
3) We also want to add two new routes/models in Q3 (summarization-large, rerank-medium) — will that change the blended rates materially?

Budget range: roughly $25k–$80k/month depending on final blended $/1M tokens. Need to align on a renewal/expansion pricing framework we can present to finance.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of AI Integrations, Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up: token volumes & next steps (post call)

Hi Samir — great meeting, thanks for the clear volumes. Quick recap and next steps below. Attachment: ACME_Renewal_PRICING_v3.xlsx (pricing workbook).

Recap / answers: 
- Blended unit economics: based on the routing mix we discussed (60% small/eff-short, 30% mid, 10% large/long), the blended list-rate is roughly $950/1M tokens. With tiered volume discounts and a committed renewal term, we can get that down to ~$600–$700/1M at the 1.2B/month steady state.
- Volume step-ups: step-downs in $/1M apply at the start of the month following the month you hit the step threshold (we snapshot usage monthly). We can include retroactive true-ups for the first quarter of the renewal to smooth transitions.
- New routes/models: adding summarization-large and rerank-medium will shift the mix — rough sensitivity shows +6–8% on blended $/1M if those routes are used at the 1.2B scale at the larger model ratios. We're showing both scenarios in the attached workbook.

Next steps: 
1) I attached a workbook with two blended scenarios and a recommended step-up schedule (months, thresholds, blended-rate bands). Please review and confirm which scenario (A: conservative routing mix, B: optimistic routing mix) aligns with your internal forecasts.
2) If scenario chosen, we will produce a formal quote (DocuSign) and proposed renewal amendment.
3) Logan — can you run the throughput/latency implications for the new routes under Dedicated capacity and confirm any additional reserved GPU needs?

Samir — if you can confirm scenario preference by EOD Thu 3/5, we can aim to have a formal quote out next week.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 14:24:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up: token volumes & next steps (pricing sensitivity)

On Tue, Mar 3, 2026 at 11:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marissa's summary looks accurate — attaching a short PDF with blended-rate math and two example step-up schedules. Attachment: redwood-blended-rate-summary.pdf
> 
A couple of clarifications from infra/cost perspective: 
- Example math (rounded):
  - Small model avg cost: $300/1M tokens
  - Mid model avg cost: $800/1M tokens
  - Large model avg cost: $2,800/1M tokens
  - With routing mix (60/30/10) base blended = ~950/1M tokens
- Committed discounts: 20% at 500M+, 30% at 1B+, with staged step-downs at 750M and 1.2B to work within your target band.
- Blended-rate application: we can offer blended invoice bands (e.g., 0-250M @X, 250-750M @Y, 750-1.2B @Z, >1.2B @W) or a single blended $/1M applied to total monthly usage — both have tradeoffs for predictability vs. smoothing.

Samir — for your budget target (~$25k–$80k/month), the low end implies a blended ~$200–$300/1M which is below our typical committed tiers unless routing is overwhelmingly small-models; can you confirm if 60% small is a hard assumption or a guess for the pilot?

I'll also flag that adding the two routes will increase peak GPU needs; Logan, please add estimated extra reserved GPU count to the workbook if possible.

— Vivek
Director, Infrastructure & Cost Optimization, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Morrison <kmorrison@acmehealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal & expansion: pricing follow-up — volume step-ups & blended rates

Thanks Marissa & Vivek — the attachments look good. Quick answers: 
- Routing mix: the 60% small / 30% mid / 10% large was a best-effort guess for pilot; it's not fixed. We expect routing to skew more toward mid-models once we add summarization-large for long-form clinical notes. Recommend we model Scenario A (conservative) for the formal quote.
- Budget: finance confirmed they can support up to ~$50k/month during pilot and will consider higher commits once we see early reductions from caching/batching.

Please proceed with Scenario A formal quote and DocuSign. Can you include a clause for a 90-day true-up window after initial step-ups so we can smooth billing while we tune routing?

Samir
